params.name: limit

params.name: sortBy
params.description:
The name of a field to sort by. Use `asc(fieldName)` or `desc(fieldName)`
to specify the sort direction as ascending or descending, respectively.

params.name: search
params.description: A search string to filter items by. Terms separated by whitespace.

params.name: key_0
params.description: Filter items by field name, using format like `fieldName[op]=value` where `op` is one of: `eq` (equals), `ne` (not equals), `cn` (contains), `sw` (starts with), `ew` (ends with), `gt` (greater than), `gte` (greater than or equal), `lt` (less than), `lte` (less than or equal), `rgx` (regular expression).

params.name: fromName
params.description: The name of the resource to copy. (required for non-singleton types)

params.name: toName
params.description: The name of the copied resource. If omitted, the name will be the same as the original resource

params.name: fromCollection
params.description: The resource collection to copy from. If omitted, will automatically use the active definition

params.name: toCollection
params.description: The resource collection to copy to. If omitted, will use the same collection as the source resource

Returns information about the currently held scan-lock, if any.

Prevents changes from being applied to the configuration system for a limited time. Time may be specified
in the request body. While this lock is held, any other changes will be queued (block) until the
lock is released. While locked, it is safe to make external changes to the filesystem.
The next call to `POST /data/api/v1/scan/config` will release the lock.
Returns information about the currently held scan-lock, if any.

Prevents changes from being applied to the project system for a limited time. Time may be specified
in the request body. While this lock is held, any other changes will be queued (block) until the
lock is released. While locked, it is safe to make external changes to the filesystem.
The next call to `POST /data/api/v1/scan/projects` will release the lock.
Returns the status of the configuration filesystem scan.

Prompts the system to scan the filesystem for configuration changes. Will also release the scan lock, if
currently being held.
Returns the status of the project filesystem scan.

Prompts the system to scan the filesystem for project changes. Will also release the scan lock, if
currently being held.
